name: Deshi Pay  bKash, Rocket, Nagad
author: Rakib Hussain

sections.description:
Deshi Pay is a lightweight yet powerful manual payment gateway designed for the Bangladeshi market. It provides a clean, modern interface for customers to get mobile banking details and submit transaction information easily.

Key Features:

  • Mobile Banking: Full support for bKash, Nagad, and Rocket.
  • Modern UI: Clean card-based design that matches any professional WordPress theme.
  • One-Click Copy: Customers can instantly copy the payment number with a dedicated “Copy” button.
  • Smart Toast Notifications: Sleek “Copied to Clipboard!” alert similar to premium mobile apps.
  • Zero Fees: Since it’s a manual gateway, you don’t have to pay any transaction fees to third-party providers.
  • Admin Control: Easily set your bKash, Nagad, and Rocket numbers from the WooCommerce settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the deshi-pay folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Click on Deshi Pay to configure your mobile numbers.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support automatic payments?

No, Deshi Pay is a manual payment gateway. It shows your payment details to the customer, and they manually send the money and provide the Transaction ID (TrxID).

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

No, this plugin is specifically built as an extension for WooCommerce.

Is there a transaction fee?

No, there are no hidden fees or transaction percentages. You get 100% of the payment directly into your mobile wallet.
